title: Independent complete-constituent image collation: Mozarabic Benedictio panis, 1804
reviewer: Independent AI source reviewer (Mozarabic blessing integration collation)
scope: The complete Benedictio panis on printed p. XVI, in the right column: from its heading below the water blessing through the final sprinkling rubric. All preceding water-blessing text on this page is excluded.
method: Fresh independent review of the retained complete source page against all 19 transcription lines and all nine semantic units. Earlier scratch receipt binding and extent hashes were stale and were not adopted as final approval.
